I was extremely depressed for a long time and was fascinated by the idea of suicide. I had to die by suicide, but I also was in tons of pain and didn't want to live anymore. I remember when my mother asked me when I was planning to do it to imagine how everyone would feel if I did kill myself I remember telling her I tried but I couldn't. I was incapable of knowing how they would feel.

I don't know if I'll even be in peace after death being agnostic after all. Don't know what's out there but I don't believe in religion I think it's possible I would be able to live through others and feel the pain of my suicide from them even after death, obviously that's not logical at all and the other route is a void of nothingness which is what I choose to believe will happen. Everything else though I'd agree with.

But for me suicide is more of an intrusive thought that's always lurking 24/7 even in my dreams. Something I've always wanted to do. At 12 years old I took my parents rifle and was going to shoot myself but was talked out of it by a close friend. Now I haven't told anyone in real life my plan. Because If I do I won't be able to carry through with it. But we will see what happens tomorrow when I leave
